assessment_objectives.objective: roles and responsibilities exist to compel data and/or process owners to assess if required security, compliance and resilience controls for the Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) under their control are designed to meet control objectives, implemented correctly and operating as intended.

Individual Contributor (IC) performance reviews cover how data and/or process owners assess if required security, compliance and resilience controls for the Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) under their control are designed to meet control objectives, implemented correctly and operating as intended.
